events.description: A large bus turns left at an intersection and collides with a group of motorcycles and possibly a small vehicle in the crosswalk, causing multiple riders to fall or be struck.
A light-colored bus turns left at an intersection and collides with a group of motorcycles and possibly a car in the cross-traffic lane, causing multiple vehicles to fall or be displaced.

A red-and-white dump truck collides with a blue-and-red covered-truck at an intersection, causing the covered-truck to be pushed sideways and rotate sharply; a small white car is also involved or impacted nearby.

The collision results in the blue-and-red truck being violently overturned or heavily tilted, with visible debris and loss of control; the dump truck continues forward, dragging or pushing the damaged vehicle.

After the initial impact, the blue-and-red truck comes to rest partially across lanes, while the dump truck and white car are seen separated but still near the crash site; residual motion and smoke/dust suggest ongoing aftermath of the crash.

A red-and-white truck collides with a blue-and-red truck at an intersection; the impact causes the blue-and-red truck to rotate sharply and lift its front wheels, while the red-and-white truck pushes it sideways across the road. A white car is also involved, being struck or squeezed between the two trucks during the collision sequence.
A blue sedan collides with a motorcycle at an intersection; the impact throws the motorcycle and rider violently, causing the car to spin and emit smoke/debris.
At a busy urban intersection, multiple motorcycles crash in rapid succession—likely due to loss of control or chain reaction—resulting in several riders and bikes lying on the road.

A multi-motorcycle collision occurs in the intersection: two motorcycles collide head-on or side-on around 91.5–92.0s, causing both to fall; a third motorcycle (green/white) then collides with the wreckage or riders on the ground at ~92.5s, resulting in multiple fallen riders and bikes scattered across the road by 93.0s.

Multiple motorcycles collide in an intersection, resulting in several riders and bikes falling to the ground; a red scooter and a green motorcycle are involved, with at least two riders on the pavement by 94.0s.
A white van collides with a motorcycle at an intersection, causing the rider to fall and the motorcycle to slide across the road.

A white pickup truck collides with a stationary blue-and-white roadside barrier or kiosk in the middle of a multi-lane road during daytime. The impact causes visible front-end damage to the truck and displaces the barrier. A person is seen lying on the ground near the barrier before and after impact, suggesting they may have been struck or thrown.

At night, a white van (possibly an SUV or minivan) traveling toward the camera collides with a dark-colored sedan approaching from the left. The collision occurs at an intersection or road junction; the white vehicle’s front-left side impacts the dark vehicle’s front-right side, causing both to rotate and come to rest angled across the road.
A motorcycle (white) collides with another motorcycle (dark) at a pedestrian crossing, causing both riders to fall. The impact and immediate fall are visible between frames f0 and f1.

After the crash, the rider of the dark motorcycle (now on the ground) is struck by the rider of the white motorcycle who remains seated and appears to kick or strike the fallen rider. This occurs while the fallen rider is motionless on the road.
A white scooter collides with a dark-colored scooter at a pedestrian crossing, causing the rider of the white scooter to fall off and the vehicle to tip over.

After the crash, multiple individuals gather around the fallen rider; physical contact occurs including pushing and apparent grappling between at least two men near the fallen scooter, suggesting mutual physical combat.
A white sedan collides with a motorcycle in the roundabout, causing the motorcycle to fall and its rider to be thrown onto the road surface.
A dark SUV appears to make contact with or narrowly miss a motorcycle exiting the roundabout; the motorcycle swerves sharply and remains upright but unstable, suggesting a near-miss or minor impact.
A white SUV enters the frame from the right and collides with a second white vehicle approaching from the left, causing both vehicles to spin and generate dust/debris.
